req.title: Reject invalid status code
req.statement: The system shall return HTTP 400 when the status code path segment is not a valid integer.

doc.reasoning: The requirement states that GET /status/<codes> must return HTTP 400 when the path segment is not a valid integer. The source code in view_status_code() catches ValueError from int(codes) and returns Response('Invalid status code', status=400). We need: (1) a positive test confirming a valid integer code works, (2) a negative test confirming a non-numeric string returns 400 with exact body, (3) boundary tests around the int() conversion edge cases (empty string, float string, alphanumeric). We also test both sides of the ValueError branch to kill comparison/constant mutations.

tests.name: test_valid_integer_status_code_returns_200
expected: HTTP response status code is exactly 200
trace: R-HTTPBIN-015 positive path: valid integer '200' must not trigger 400
tests.executable:
from httpbin.core import app
client = app.test_client()

def test_valid_integer_status_code_returns_200():
    r = client.get('/status/200')
    assert r.status_code == 200

test_valid_integer_status_code_returns_200()
